origin.description: True when the object inherits the mcmc.list class.
origin.details: An mcmc.list is a list of mcmc chains that share start, end, thin, and variable names. A single chain and a plain list do not inherit that class.
origin.example: n <- 2000; i <- seq_len(n); x <- cbind(sin(i/3)+0.2*cos(i), cos(i/5)+0.01*i, rep(2, n)); y <- cbind(sin(i/4)+0.15*cos(i/2), cos(i/6)+0.005*i, rep(1, n)); chain <- mcmc(x); cat(paste(ifelse(c(is.mcmc.list(mcmc.list(chain, mcmc(y))), is.mcmc.list(chain), is.mcmc.list(list(chain)), is.mcmc.list(NULL)), "TRUE", "FALSE"), collapse=" "), "\n")

translation.description: True when the object is an McmcList.
translation.details: An McmcList holds chains that share start, end, thin, and variable names. A single Mcmc chain and a plain list are not an McmcList.
translation.example: n = 2000; i = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float); x = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 3) + 0.2 * np.cos(i), np.cos(i / 5) + 0.01 * i, np.full(n, 2.0))); y = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 4) + 0.15 * np.cos(i / 2), np.cos(i / 6) + 0.005 * i, np.full(n, 1.0))); chain = as_mcmc(x); flags = [is_mcmc_list(as_mcmc_list([chain, as_mcmc(y)])), is_mcmc_list(chain), is_mcmc_list([chain]), is_mcmc_list(None)]; print(" ".join("TRUE" if flag else "FALSE" for flag in flags))
